# fmt

Published version: `cli/fmt@0.1.6`. See the release inventory;
[latest.json](../../tests/release/latest.json) records the uploaded coordinates.

Reformat text paragraphs for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/fmt@0.1.6 [-WIDTH] [-w WIDTH] [-g GOAL] [-suct] [-p PREFIX] [FILE...]
```

## Supported scope

Read files or stdin, preserve indentation and separate paragraphs at blank lines. The default width is 75.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-w` / `--width` | required | Set maximum width (0 through 2500). Default: `75`. |
| `-g` / `--goal` | required | Set preferred width. |
| `-s` / `--split-only` | none | Split long lines without joining input lines. |
| `-u` / `--uniform-spacing` | none | Use one inter-word space and two after sentences. |
| `-c` / `--crown-margin` | none | Allow a different first-line indent. |
| `-t` / `--tagged-paragraph` | none | Preserve hanging indentation. |
| `-p` / `--prefix` | required | Reformat matching prefixed lines only. Default: `""`. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Argument and exit-status contract

Option values and operands after -- remain literal during alias normalization.

See the [finite diagnostic profile](../../docs/compatibility.md#extensions-and-diagnostics).

## Limitations

- Uses C-byte columns, not Unicode display widths. A long word can exceed the selected width.
- Does not rewrite input files.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/fmt@0.1.6 -w 60 notes.txt
moonx cli/fmt@0.1.6 -s -w 40 notes.txt
```
